newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schenker sees Latam as next growth area.
newsitem.headline: Schenker sees Latam as next growth area.

text.p: Global freight forwarder Schenker International said it will target Latin America as its next major growth region following investment in North America and Asia.
The German-owned company would develop projects in Mexico, Brazil and the Caribbean as well as in English-speaking Africa, a statement from parent company Schenker-Rhenus said.
In Asia, Schenker International is due to open its Singapore logistics centre offering clients faster direct routes in early 1998, the statement said.
Transatlantic and inner-American routes have been improved with the opening of a Miami gateway and co-ordination office, it added.
Schenker International airfreight managers at the recent company meeting in South Africa outlined future plans and services to some 200 shippers from across the country, the statement said.
Schenker International is the air and sea freight forwarding division of Schenker-Rhenus, which is part of the Stinnes trading group. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
